text: A very special island is inhabited only by pioneers and laggards. Pioneers always tell the truth, and laggards always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: James, and Owen. James said, "if Owen is a laggard then Owen is a pioneer." "James is a laggard or Owen is a pioneer," Owen claimed. So who is a pioneer and who is a laggard? (Format your answer like: "James is a pioneer/laggard, and Owen is a pioneer/laggard")
